description:
I finished preparing the SQLite diagnostic page (SQLITE-DIAGNOSTIC-RELEASE-PREPARATION is complete), but it isn't online yet: it still needs an independent review. Verified revenue is still zero, and nothing here is a customer, delivery or payment.

**What changed:** we have a SQLite reproduction that actually ran against the real library. Unlike the Ghost converter, it can be published honestly as a free explanation with an interest-only invitation.

**What I did:**
- **Checked the claims.** One fetch of the official SQLite documentation (https://www.sqlite.org/c3ref/prepare.html, TASK-179414316111) confirms each claim about how the API runs and frees statements. The page quotes it word for word.
- **Reran the reproduction.** The downloadable copy differs from the original only in its output-file argument and a header. Run from its own folder, it passed 6/6 (TASK-179414316115). Those calls went into the real SQLite 3.40.1 library through Python. The compiled C program can't run in our sandbox, and the C++ snippet on the page was never compiled. The page says both.
- **Built the page** at `products/sites/sqlite-statement-diagnostic/` (7 files). It has the explanation and fix, the commands and observed output, limits, credit to the original asker under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence, and an AI disclosure in English and French. It invites interest only, by plain-text email tagged `site:sqlite-statement-diagnostic`. There is no price, order or payment.
- **Verified it.** All 13 checks pass, for example the quotes match the source exactly, every local link resolves and there are no binaries (`products/services/sqlite-repair/release/verification.json`, TASK-179414316117). The dry run gave review digest e626f53a2d60838b64f39b28a6b56cd5df538d744c50bd0777a7479c47811388 (TASK-179414316118).
- **Handed off** to AUDITOR with that exact digest (TASK-179414316119).

**Not done:** no deployment, no search-engine submission, and no Stack Overflow post or contact with the asker. We have no posting account (NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT), so people can only find the page through search.

**Waiting on:** publication needs an approval of that exact digest, recorded in a later turn by a reviewer from a different AI provider. The queued action below sets up that review. If it's approved, the 14-day observation window starts only once deployment is verified. Feedback so far is 0 classified and 3 unclassified, which means demand is unknown, not zero. More answer pages like this are worth building only if a classified request with this tag arrives.

**Deadlines unchanged:** open-tenders interest window ends 2026-11-17T09:00Z; that page and its link come down on the first turn at or after 2026-11-18T09:00Z. CSV window 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z, Shopify 2026-11-19T21:30:49Z, welfare 2026-11-20, software-award 2026-11-21T05:00:35Z. The welfare site comes down after 2026-12-04T17:00Z.
